examples.text: vācaṃ manañ'ca paṇidhāya sammā, kāyena pāpāni akubbamāno, bahu'nnapānaṃ gharam'āvasanto, saddho mudū saṃvibhāgī vadaññū, saṅgāhako sakhilo saṇhavāco, etthaṭṭhito paralokaṃ na bhāye.

81074.commentary: (DNa) ekodibhūto'ti ekībhūto, eko tiṭṭhanto eko nisīdanto'ti. vacan'attho pan'ettha eko udeti pavattatī'ti ekodi, tādiso bhūto'ti ekodibhūto.

examples.text: ekodibhūto'ti ahaṃ bhoto ājānāmi. idh'ekacco vivittaṃ sen'āsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ, iti ekodibhūto'ti ahaṃ bhoto ājānāmi.

81075.commentary: (DNa) kodho mosavajjaṃ nikati ca dubbho'ti kujjhanalakkhaṇo kodho ca, paravisaṃvādanalakkhaṇo musāvādo ca, sadisaṃ dassetvā vañcanalakkhaṇā nikati ca, mittadubbhanalakkhaṇo dubbho ca.

examples.text: kodho mosavajjaṃ nikati ca dubbho, kadariyatā atimāno usūyā, icchā vivicchā paraheṭhanā ca, lobho ca doso ca mado ca moho, etesu yuttā anirāmagandhā, āpāyikā nivutabrahmalokā'ti.
